project.name: Montrave
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 5 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. Montrave House accommodation and private estate buildings are not assumed to be public attractions. Montrave Hill is a different geographic feature and is not substituted for the locality.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Montrave is retained for regional completeness, but a strict-boundary current-web audit found no independently visitable attraction, café-led daytime stop, maintained place-specific trail, public picnic facility, visitor car park or public toilet.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Dog access is limited or unconfirmed and no dedicated dog destination is assumed.
